Chapter 6810: I Can Kill You

Chapter 6810: I Can Kill You

Many stole glances at Blaze Emperor after hearing her question.

“Thunder, do you know what you are saying?” Blaze Ancestor said. This went beyond merely disagreeing with him.

“Ancestor, may I ask how we, the final bastion of Stygian, have survived all this time?” She took a deep breath.

“Never gave up.” He said.

“Yes, Ancestor, our home is small and cultivation is difficult, we all know this. Nevertheless, we continue onward and become stronger, step by step. I know the path is difficult and will most likely end with death, but this isn’t a reason to give in. The light of the dao heart does not abandon us, and conversely, we can also light up the dao heart just like the temporal fairy. She descended and blessed us with her light, we must make good use of it instead of walking toward our demise.” She spoke slowly.

“Your Majesty...” Those from Tinyleaf were stirred by her speech.

“We will never give in.” Someone whispered.

“Yes, we will never give it!” Some became bolder and shouted.

“We have reached the higher realms of cultivation and are leaders. If others can persevere, we must do even better, never negotiate or submit to the darkness.” She continued.

“Never negotiate, never submit!” Those from Thunder Kingdom started yelling as well.

Tinyleaf was but a small corner, just a speck of dust. However, the city lord, cultivators, and even mortals never surrendered to the demonic horde.

Could Thunder Kingdom and Blaze Sect do the same?

Her words struck the hearts of everyone present. Resistance and indomitability were engraved into the bones of all living beings in Golden Lamp, passed down through generations.

They rejected the darkness and fought against Devouring Alliance. They were sparks of light taking root in Stygian, insignificant yet stubborn.

Tenacity defined them and allowed Golden Lamp to endure. Although it was created by a mighty dao heart, this couldn’t persevere if the people themselves had abandoned their resolve. The darkness would take over internally then.

Blaze Ancestor sighed and said: “Not trying to compromise, I only wanted to know what it is.”

“Death if no compromise.” An imperial aura erupted.

Everyone looked up and saw an eagle with halos around its wings. Primordial chaos energy poured down like waterfalls. The aura swept people off their feet instantly.

“Eagle God!” Thunder Emperor thrust her spear, stopping the aura.

He was potentially the grandson of Primal Eagle. His appearance shocked the crowd.

“Your city has fallen, you should not be here. The light of the dao heart will destroy your heart devil.” Blaze Ancestor said.

“That does not scare me.” Eagle God laughed: “The light does shake our fallen dao heart but that’s only for overlords and up. Lowly cultivators such as ourselves are unaffected. Moreover, I don’t have that many Dark Desire laws.”

This meant others could freely roam in Golden Lamp.

“I can kill you instead.” Thunder Emperor said.

“I am not here to destroy your kingdom or attack Golden Lamp. We came from here and are still attached to...” He said.

“The moment you joined Dark Desire and left Golden Lamp, you are no longer one of us.” She said.

“So you seek destruction?” He asked.

“Golden Lamp will not fall because of you or Frenzy. You cannot compare to the Fallen Ten.” She said.

“True, but we can destroy your kingdom. Be smart and hand the shrine over, I’ll leave then.” He uttered coldly.
